Living on the Veg - A Week in Review 🌱

Sharing all my fun my fun adventures, no matter where in the world I am!

Here are some fun highlights from Chicago:
- Did I have an entire photo shoot with the adorable blue cat cocktail at @mirurestaurant terrace?! *maybe* 😻💙
- When one of your all-time favorite restaurants @osteriaviastato asks you to be an official ambassador, it’s an easy “yes”! 🥰🍕
- Checked-out the new @illy_chicago for breakfast and loved the breakfast croissant sandwich with egg white, avocado and cheese. Wasn’t as impressed with my almond rose iced latte cause I tasted no rose! I’ll have to give it another try. 👍🏼
- Been a minute since I’ve been to @theoakvillechicago. Absolutely loved the beautiful and delicious cocktails and that peanut butter chocolate dessert situation was chefs kiss. A MUST order. 🤩
- A weekend tip: go get the freshly baked cinnamon rolls from @sweetmandybs, they are out of this world. Truly some of my favorite! 💕
- First time at @pizzalobo in the West Loop and not my last. Enjoyed the pizza, drinks and laid back patio vibes. 
- Wondering if this little guy was going to run my friend over. He did not. 🤪
- Got the BEST vegan protein shake from @theproteinbar. I got the Hippie made with oatmeal, chocolate plant-based protein, almond milk, peanut butter, banana and cinnamon. Tasted like an oatmeal pb and chocolate cookie. 🙌🏽
- Sunday night called from some of my fav Detroit style pizza and breadsticks from @jetspizza. Don’t forget their famous ranch, IYKYK. 🍕
- Some captures of my beautiful city through the week. Can never take enough photos, which is my why I also am always running out of space on my phone. 🤷🏻‍♀️

Thanks for following along and follow @vegtourist for all the best veg finds! Here’s to a great week ahead!

St. Moritz, pt. 1 🤍

Day one at Privé Retreat and Switzerland wasted absolutely no time impressing.

We stepped straight into history with a tour of the legendary Badrutt’s Palace, capped by Paradiso, the iconic ski club where glamour, altitude, and après culture collide in the most unapologetically fabulous way.

From there, the Kulm Hotel reminded us that Swiss hospitality is equal parts precision and joy. Ice skating, winter magic, and a send off that felt thoughtful, warm, and impeccably done. The kind of experience that stays with you long after you leave.

We’re just getting started. So much more on the extraordinary properties that we saw is to come, but suffice it to say Switzerland is officially on our radar, and we cannot wait to plan celebrations in this incredible country.

More soon. Always with intention. ✨

Watching two families, two cultures, and two stories come together so intentionally was something I’ll never forget.

Happy anniversary, Ben & Selena. Thank you for trusting me to create a celebration that reflected your story so authentically. 🤍

Sometimes the most beautiful part of a Chicago wedding isn’t the skyline…

It’s the person you’re standing beside. 🤍

After planning weddings for 24 years, one thing has never changed…

The most beautiful moments are never the ones you can buy. They’re the ones you feel.

These images of Jordan and Nick’s wedding day is a beautiful reminder of that.

Not the timeline.

Not the flowers.

Not even the breathtaking venue.

It’s the feeling.

The hand you never want to let go of.

The deep breath before walking into a room filled with everyone you love.

The smile that quietly says, “We made it.”

The Chicago skyline was the perfect backdrop, but the love they shared, the family who surrounded them, and the incredible team who brought this day to life made it truly unforgettable.

Jordan & Nick, thank you for allowing all of us to be part of such a beautiful chapter in your story. Wishing you a lifetime of moments that feel just like this. ✨
